utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?
Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just a bit busy with schoolwork.
Oh, it sounds like you have something exciting planned for the weekend! What are you going to do?
I'm thinking of going to the new cinema with some friends. I'm just trying to figure out the best way to get there.
The one by the old town loop? That's a nice area! Are you going with friends who know the way?
Yes, I'm going with a few friends. We were looking at the map earlier to see if that loop is the quickest route.
Using the map on your phone is a smart choice these days. Just make sure your phone is charged so you don't lose your way!
That's a great point! I'll make sure to bring my portable charger just in case we need the directions later.
I understand, dear. Having a backup makes things simpler. Just be safe and mind the traffic on the road.
Do you have any other plans for the day after your little trip to the cinema?
Not really, just planning to relax and maybe catch up on some shows once I'm back home.
